description: The module's DNS record on the TAPPaaS resolver.
_note: update-service.sh execs install-service.sh, which is reconcile-in-place: it creates or updates the record and is safe to re-run. apply:'reconcile' says exactly that.

ip.note: The address the module's name resolves to. Re-pointing a record is a resolver update; nothing on the guest changes, so no reboot and no downtime. An absent ip means the module resolves from its DHCP lease via masqdns instead, which is the normal case.
